draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (jungle→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: We won the first two teamfights and cashed neither; they won three and cashed all three — that's the whole 10–21 loss.
coaching.team: Four of five lane reads were ours or even, and we took the 11-min fight at our Fangtooth 3-1 and the 15-min fight at our outer tower 3-1 — then banked nothing from either. From 17 to 20 minutes the game flipped on picks: the 17.2 skirmish went 0-2 under our own tower and traded straight into their Fangtooth at 18.2, the 18.3 fight opened 4v5 with Murdock already down, and the inner and outer towers fell by 19.8. The call: when we win a fight, the next 90 seconds belong to Fangtooth or a tower — not to resetting into their picks.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Won fights converted 0-for-2 against their 3-for-3, and the 17–20 minute pick cascade: Kallari and Steel caught at 17.2 bought their 18.2 Fangtooth, then two towers by 19.8.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock's lane read even into Drongo and the trouble came outside it: three deaths caught alone — 13.7 by The Fey (the outer tower fell at 15.1), 17.8 by Drongo (their Fangtooth and our inner tower followed), 25.9 by The Fey again. And at the 24.9 Orb Prime fight the macro shows Mr_Meat31 alive and never joining a 2-3 loss. The carry's rotations decide those two fights; move with the group when Orb is up.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari won the jungle read all game and led the team with 8 kills — but objective damage was 0, and the two won teamfights at 11 and 15 minutes cashed nothing. The 17.2 death traded into their 18.2 Fangtooth. On a pick hero the kill is step one; step two is spending the numbers advantage on Fangtooth or a tower before resetting.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Greystone won the offlane read against Grux all game, but the scoreline was 2/5/1 with only 372 objective damage — the winning lane never became pressure. Caught at 8.6 by Grux, and the 18.6 death fed the inner-and-outer tower cascade. A won offlane should be shoving and rotating into the fights the team kept taking short-handed.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage
